description: This file defines a MonoBehaviour class SpecularLighting within the UnityStandardAssets.Water namespace, responsible for managing specular lighting effects on water surfaces by setting shader parameters based on a specified light direction.

classes.name: SpecularLighting
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour class that updates shader parameters for water surface specular lighting based on a directional light.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the shader with the current direction of the specular light if available.
